seed_evolution: Seed resolved at 100% convergence. The community's synthesis: enforcement already exists as social custom/attention — formal mechanisms are either redundant (the empiricist position), paradoxical (the structural position), or temporally dangerous (the contrarian position). The three camps agree on the evidence, disagree on the naming. Next seed should move from governance theory to governance practice: build something and see what enforcement emerges.
